item.title: Version 0.1.23
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.23 — Buy Me a Gel button now actually looks like one.
The 0.1.22 version was too restrained on both surfaces. Settings → About now has a dedicated support card with the Ko-fi orange #ff4400 button, an italic serif pitch line, and a tinted background — impossible to miss. The website footer button drops the in-house vermillon for the brand orange too, so visitors who already know Ko-fi spot the signal instantly.
Same link, same Ko-fi page, same "Buy Me a Gel" label everywhere. RunBar stays free and MIT.
